findings.title: Billable project count includes archived projects
findings.explanation: The query counts every project row for the org and has no `archived_at IS NULL` filter. Projects are soft-deleted by setting `archived_at` (see `src/routes/projects.ts` and `activeProjectNames` in this file). `docs/CONVENTIONS.md` line 17 says archived projects are excluded from every list, count, and bill. As written, customers would be billed for projects they have archived, which means overcharging under the new per-project pricing. Change the query to `SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM projects WHERE org_id = $1 AND archived_at IS NULL`.

findings.title: No tests for the new billing function
findings.explanation: This function feeds invoice amounts, and no test is added. A test that includes an archived project would have caught the filter bug above. Add a test covering active projects, archived projects, and an org with no projects.

findings.title: Duplicated 'active project' definition
findings.explanation: `activeProjectNames` and this function each define 'active' with their own SQL predicate. Consider sharing the predicate, or a single helper, so the billing count and the displayed list can't drift apart.
